name: Ankr
tagline: Multi-chain public RPC and Advanced API for balances, NFTs, and tokens
description: Ankr provides free and premium multi-chain JSON-RPC endpoints plus an Advanced API for token balances, NFT data, and blockchain queries across many networks.

auth.details: Public RPC works without a key at path endpoints; Advanced API and higher limits use an API key from the Ankr dashboard.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public Node API is free. Freemium includes 200M API credits/month. Public and Freemium Node API guarantee about 1,800 requests/min across all endpoints; Freemium Advanced API allows 50 requests/min, capped at 500 per 10 min.

rate_limits: Public/Freemium Node API: about 1,800 requests/min guaranteed across all endpoints, with more possible depending on load. Freemium Advanced API: 50 requests/min, maximum 500/10 min. Premium Node API: up to about 1,500 requests/sec per endpoint, or 4,000/sec for Solana; Advanced API: 1,000+/min.
use_cases: call eth_blockNumber on Ethereum via public RPC
fetch NFT metadata for a wallet
